title: Android: Restore mark older/newer read options for long press
summary: Previous to the latest update you could mark older or newer stories for a feed as read by long pressing. Could this be restored as an option for long press? Perhaps it would need to be based on oldest/newest sorting. e.g. with oldest first it marks older stories read, with newest first it marks newer stories read.

# [Android: Restore mark older/newer read options for long press](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/android-restore-mark-older-newer-read-options-for-long-press/13837)


[problem](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/problem/6)

September 17, 2026, 1:44pm 1


Previous to the latest update you could mark older or newer stories for a feed as read by long pressing. Could this be restored as an option for long press?


Perhaps it would need to be based on oldest/newest sorting. e.g. with oldest first it marks older stories read, with newest first it marks newer stories read.
